subject.title: fix(status): use legacy Codex OAuth profiles for OpenAI usage

question: Should `status --usage` be allowed to read retired `openai-codex:*` OAuth/token profiles for canonical `openai` usage before users run `openclaw doctor --fix`?
rationale: Repository policy normally keeps legacy OpenAI-Codex state in doctor/migration paths, while this PR intentionally adds a runtime compatibility exception for a shipped upgrade state.

options.title: Approve usage-only bridge
options.body: Accept the runtime compatibility exception, then refresh the PR against current main while preserving API-key exclusion and separation from Codex synthetic app-server auth.

options.title: Keep doctor-only migration
options.body: Close or pause the PR and require affected users to run `openclaw doctor --fix` before `status --usage` reads legacy OpenAI-Codex profile state.

options.title: Narrow before approval
options.body: Ask for a smaller patch or documentation of the removal boundary before allowing any runtime legacy-profile fallback.

recommendation.title: Approve usage-only bridge
recommendation.body: Accept the runtime compatibility exception, then refresh the PR against current main while preserving API-key exclusion and separation from Codex synthetic app-server auth.

likelyOwner.reason: This account authored the OpenAI provider identity migration and is the strongest history owner for deciding whether a runtime legacy-profile exception belongs here.
